resources.string: Experimental OVRPlugin-to-OpenXR compatibility. It replaces the game\'s OVRPlugin library, may not work with every title, and requires re-optimizing/reinstalling the game. Keep a backup; saves/OBB may be affected by the signature change.
The OpenXR compatibility library is missing from this OLFX build. Reinstall the official OLFX APK.
%1$s was optimized with a different runtime/loader. Re-optimize and install to apply the current hand-tracking route. This replaces the OLFX signature again; internal saves/OBB may be affected.

Quest games use OculusXR automatically when the Meta runtime is detected, except when OLFX camera hands are enabled: Auto then keeps the Monado/OpenXR hand path. You can pin Monado, OculusXR, or experimental OpenXR compatibility per game.
OculusXR not detected on this device
OculusXR requires the Meta runtime on a compatible device. OLFX does not download or emulate it.
Undistorted left/right views for screens used without headset lenses. Restart the game after changing.
Close the game and restart the runtime to apply display changes.
Close any running XR game first. Active sessions may be interrupted.
Runtime shutdown requested. Open the game again.
Runtime is not running or is still bound by a game.
Gyroscope and accelerometer detected for 3-DoF head rotation.
Gyroscope or accelerometer missing; head rotation may be unavailable.
Phone sensors provide rotation, not positional 6-DoF tracking. Hand tracking requires camera permission and a supported OpenXR hand-tracking game.
Compatibility depends on the game, OpenXR extensions, device and installed runtime. OculusXR is proprietary and must already be present; universal compatibility and zero lag cannot be guaranteed.
Use your own hands in VR games
Allowed. Hands work in games that ask for hand tracking.
Not allowed yet: games will not see your hands.
Turn on if your left hand shows up as the right one
Put the phone in the headset and hold your hands in front of the rear camera, 30 to 60 cm away, in good light. An open palm is picked up fastest. Restart the game after changing a setting.
This is not a supported APK. Split APK/APKS/XAPK/APKM packages are not supported.
Patch: optimization — less memory and load
Patch: normal immersion — closer to original
%1$s is already installed. Updating requires the same signing key, otherwise installation will fail.
Patch created as %1$s. The installed game has a different signature, so the original must be removed; internal saves and OBB files may be lost. Remove original and install patch?
The signature changed, so the original must be removed. Internal saves and OBB files may be lost. Remove original and install patch?
Original was not removed; installation canceled. APK kept: %1$s
Allow OLFX to install apps, then retry.
Could not open the Android installation confirmation.
Split APK games are not supported yet
Point the rear camera at your hands. Start the test and check the skeleton, FPS and inference time.
Camera permission is required for the hand-tracking test.
Hand tracking test is not available in this build.
No accessible rear camera was found on this device.
The camera was disconnected. Start the test again.
The camera could not be started. Close other camera apps and try again.
The hand-tracking model could not be loaded.
This camera did not provide a supported hand-tracking frame format.
Hand tracking is switched off in OLFX settings.

%1$s has no OLFX VR patch. The optimization patch can improve runtime visibility and loading, but changes the APK signature: replacing the original may remove internal saves and OBB data. Patch and reinstall, or launch the installed game unchanged?
Allow OLFX to install unknown apps in Android settings. The prepared APK is kept and installation continues when you return.
Choose how to click. Pinch click uses camera hand tracking and requires enabling the OLFX accessibility service. The tap position approximates the pinch position in the camera image.
To click by pinching, enable “OLFX pinch click” in Android accessibility settings. OLFX never enables it automatically.

Hand tracking routes: OpenXR/Monado receives OLFX camera joints (XR_EXT_hand_tracking, plus Meta aim/capsules output). OculusXR passthrough uses only Meta\'s native hand tracking. VrApi/OVRPlugin titles need the experimental OpenXR compatibility option; OLFX does not inject camera hands into Meta\'s proprietary runtime.
Close the game first. This calls xrCreateHandTrackerEXT and xrLocateHandJointsEXT through the OpenXR loader.
To play, %1$s must be installed once as an OLFX optimized version. After that, Play opens it directly.
No OpenXR runtime is available for this game.
Not enough free space to optimize this APK.

Android blocked OLFX from starting %1$s. The game\'s launch activity is not exported or requires a permission OLFX does not have. Open the game\'s app info, or reinstall the original/OLFX-patched game so it exposes a normal launch entry.
Camera permission was not granted; the game will start without OLFX hand tracking.
OLFX could not start the camera service before launch. Hand tracking may be unavailable in this game; reopen OLFX and grant camera permission.
